typography.notes: Ensure heading tracking is tight (`tracking-tighter`). Body text should be highly legible and utilitarian. DO NOT USE Inter, Roboto, or Lato for headings.

colors.notes: High contrast minimal UI. Monochrome base allows the colored status tags to pop and draw immediate attention. Avoid excessive gradients.

layouts.marketing_pages: Use radical asymmetry and generous spacing (p-12 to p-24). Start with strong typography. Bento grids for features. Hero image with a maximum overlay of bg-black/40.
layouts.dashboard_pages: High density grid. Strict F-pattern hierarchy. Minimal borders (1px solid border) with subtle or no shadows for data tables. Use full height and responsive grids for the CRM view.

grids.marketing_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Span logic for 3 features: one featured (col-span-12 or md:col-span-8) and others col-span-4 or col-span-6. Avoid perfectly equal squares.
grids.dashboard_table: Full-width layouts with dense row spacing for high data visibility. Actionable-first layout.

components.navigation: Sticky nav with Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60). Solid bottom border 1px.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-border), no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). High contrast background (black in light mode, white in dark mode). Hover: invert colors or change opacity.
components.data_table: Use Shadcn Table. Dense rows. Action buttons (Edit/View) next to the data. Status tags must use pill shapes (rounded-full) with custom background/text colors for VALID, EXPIRED, NEEDS_REVIEW.

visual_enhancers.motion: Lenis smooth scrolling for marketing pages. Hover states for all table rows and buttons. Micro-animations for data loading.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton on the feature grid using 'Grid Borders' pattern.

image_urls.description: Modern steel framework structure, representing automated construction compliance.
Architect/contractor working on a draft, used as background or side visual for the upload page.

icons: lucide-react for sharp, consistent, technical icon representations.
3d_libraries: Not recommended for this specific compliance B2B dashboard. Focus on fast load times, information density, and clean UI.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. All form inputs and buttons must have focus states (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2`).
accessibility.tags: Ensure tag text is readable against the bright status background colors. White text on Green/Red/Orange tags is recommended, or very dark text if APCA requires it.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the public marketing page with a bold hero section ('Stop Chasing Subcontractors. Automate Your COI Compliance.') and a bento-style 3-column feature grid (AI COI Extraction, Background SMS/Email Drip Reminders, Live Trade Dashboard with color-coded status tags).
Implement the Pricing block for Pro Plan at $149/mo with Stripe checkout placeholder/button.

Implement the Authenticated Contractor Compliance Dashboard: Use Shadcn Table for the compliance documents. Apply specific color-codes for tags: VALID (green #02C039), EXPIRED (red #FF3B30), NEEDS_REVIEW/INSUFFICIENT (orange #FF9500).
Add a search bar and status filter above the compliance table.
Create the Invite Subcontractor form page.
Create a mobile-optimized Subcontractor public document upload page with confirmation view.
Create a CRM view for prospects/outreach.
Apply 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
NEVER use generic transition like 'transition: all'. Explicitly specify transitions.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (sharp edges for Swiss Brutalism) with interaction animations.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use generous spacing. If typical is p-4, use p-8 or p-12.
Implement hover states, transitions, and entrance animations for elements.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
Prioritize using Shadcn UI components from src/components/ui.
